claim: load_config() re-reads and parses settings.json on every request inside the request loop.
counterevidence: Config could be intended to change at runtime; confirm a reload path is not required before caching.
evidence: src/app/handler.py calls load_config() once per request
load_config opens and json.loads settings.json on each call

evidence_fields.root_cause: Parsed configuration is not cached between requests.
evidence_fields.cost_signal: one file open and JSON parse per request
evidence_fields.cheaper_alternative: parse once at startup or memoize with an mtime check

risk_score.risk_reason: Local internal change behind the same output.

recommendation: Cache parsed config; verify outputs are unchanged.
title: Repeated full re-parse of config on every request
